item.title: Florida court rules MMTC cap, horizontal integration mandate unconstitutional
item.description: The state of Florida has been supporting a medical marijuana program that restricts most from entering into the cannabis space, but not for long. A Florida judge ruled the current system limiting licenses for MMTCs, or medical marijuana treatment centers, as unconstitutional.
